d:
Sasha Mirchandani, Founder & Managing Partner at Kae Capital and Co-Founder of Mumbai Angels one of India's earliest and most respected venture investors, who backed India's first unicorn.
He explains:
• Why he believes conscientiousness beats raw talent in every founder he has ever backed
• How his father made him sell Onida TVs door to door so he would never feel entitled
• How to spot a founder who will never quit before you write a single cheque
• Why he loves funding founders who have already failed once and came back smarter
